        "contents": "const TechPointEditModal: React.FC&lt;TechPointEditModalProps&gt; = \n\n    &lt;Modal\n      title=\"Json导入技术点\"\n      open={importModalVisible}\n      onCancel={() =&gt; {\n        setImportModalVisible(false);\n        setImportJsonText('');\n      }}\n      width={700}\n      footer={[\n        &lt;Button key=\"cancel\" onClick={() =&gt; {\n          setImportModalVisible(false);\n          setImportJsonText('');\n        }}&gt;\n          取消\n        &lt;/Button&gt;,\n        &lt;Button key=\"import\" type=\"primary\" onClick={handleImportJson}&gt;\n          导入\n        &lt;/Button&gt;,\n      ]}\n    &gt;\n      &lt;div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}&gt;\n        &lt;div style={{ marginTop: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}&gt;\n          &lt;span style={{ fontSize: '12px' }}&gt;\n            支持标准JSON格式，以下字段会自动导入，其他字段（技术IP、技术领域、技术类型、优先级、状态等）需要手动维护。\n          &lt;/span&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;pre style={{ \n          background: '#f5f5f5', \n          padding: '12px', \n          borderRadius: '4px', \n          fontSize: '12px',\n          maxHeight: '300px',\n          overflow: 'auto',\n          marginTop: '8px'\n        }}&gt;\n{&#96;{\n  \"technical_name\": \"技术点名称（必填，也支持name）\",\n  \"description\": \"描述（必填）\",\n  \"tech_principle\": \"技术原理\",\n  \"value\": \"价值（也支持tech_value）\",\n  \"boundaries\": \"适用边界（也支持tech_boundary）\",\n  \"highlights\": [\"亮点1\", \"亮点2\"],\n  \"evidence_measured\": [\"实测1\", \"实测2\"],\n  \"certifications\": [\"认证1\", \"认证2\"]（也支持evidence_certified）,\n  \"evidence_comparison\": [\"对比1\", \"对比2\"],\n  \"release_time\": \"2025年3月\"（也支持release_date: \"2025-03-01\"）\n}&#96;}\n        &lt;/pre&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;Input.TextArea\n        rows={15}\n        placeholder=\"请粘贴JSON数据...\"\n        value={importJsonText}\n        onChange={(e) =&gt; setImportJsonText(e.target.value)}\n      /&gt;\n    &lt;/Modal&gt;\n    &lt;/&gt;\n  );\n};\n\nexport default TechPointEditModal;",

        "contents": "const TechPointForm: React.FC&lt;TechPointFormProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleInputChange = (\n    e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;\n      HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement | HTMLSelectElement\n    &gt;,\n  ) =&gt; {\n    const { name, value } = e.target;\n    const fieldName = name as keyof TechPointFormData;\n\n    let processedValue: any = value;\n    if (fieldName === \"category_id\") {\n      processedValue = parseInt(value, 10) || 0;\n    }\n\n    setFormData((prev) =&gt; ({\n      ...prev,\n      [fieldName]: processedValue,\n    }));\n\n    // 实时验证\n    validateField(fieldName, processedValue);\n  };\n\n  const handleBrandChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLSelectElement&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const brandId = parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || null;\n    setSelectedBrandId(brandId);\n  };\n\n  const handleModelChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLSelectElement&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const modelId = parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || null;\n    setSelectedModelId(modelId);\n  };\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n\n    if (!validateForm()) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsSubmitting(true);\n    setSubmitError(\"\");\n    setSubmitSuccess(false);\n\n    try {\n      const success = await onSubmit(formData);\n      if (success) {\n        setSubmitSuccess(true);\n        // 重置表单\n        if (!techPoint) {\n          setFormData({\n            name: \"\",\n            description: \"\",\n            category_id: 0,\n            type: TechType.FEATURE,\n            priority: TechPriority.MEDIUM,\n            status: TechStatus.ACTIVE,\n          });\n          setErrors({});\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"提交失败:\", error);\n      setSubmitError(\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"提交失败，请重试\",\n      );\n    } finally {\n      setIsSubmitting(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getTypeLabel = (type: TechType): string =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "import api from './api';\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\nimport { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from '../types/techPoint';\n\n/**\n * 技术点同步服务\n * 用于与 TPD2 项目进行技术点信息同步\n * \n * 后续实现功能：\n * 1. 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n * 2. 增量同步（只同步更新的数据）\n * 3. 双向同步（支持从 TPD2 到 todify3 和反向）\n * 4. 同步冲突处理\n * 5. 同步日志记录\n */\nexport const techPointSyncService = {\n  /**\n   * 从 TPD2 同步技术点数据\n   * @param options 同步选项\n   */\n  async syncFromTPD2(options?: {\n    fullSync?: boolean; // 是否全量同步\n    lastSyncTime?: string; // 上次同步时间，用于增量同步\n  }): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;{\n    synced: number; // 同步的技术点数量（总数）\n    updated: number; // 更新的技术点数量\n    created: number; // 创建的技术点数量\n    errors: number; // 错误数量\n  }&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await api.post('/tech-points/sync', {\n        fullSync: options?.fullSync ?? false,\n        lastSyncTime: options?.lastSyncTime,\n      });\n      // 后端返回的格式是 { success, message, data: { total, created, updated, errors } }\n      if (response.data &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        const stats = response.data.data;\n        return {\n          success: response.data.success ?? true,\n          data: {\n            synced: stats.total || (stats.created || 0) + (stats.updated || 0),\n            updated: stats.updated || 0,\n            created: stats.created || 0,\n            errors: stats.errors || 0,\n          },\n          message: response.data.message,\n        };\n      }\n      return response.data;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: '同步技术点数据失败'\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点到 TPD2\n   * @param techPointIds 要同步的技术点ID列表，如果不提供则同步所有\n   */\n,\n};",

        "contents": "/**\n * 从TPD2项目API导入所有技术点数据\n * 一次性导入所有技术点及其关联数据\n */\n\nimport axios from 'axios';\nimport { DatabaseManager, db } from '../config/database';\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel, carModelModel } from '../models';\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority, KnowledgeType, DifficultyLevel, CreateKnowledgePointDTO } from '../types/database';\nimport { KnowledgePointService } from '../services/knowledgePointService';\n\ninterface TPD2TechPoint {\n  id?: number;\n  name: string;\n  description?: string;\n  category_id?: number;\n  category_name?: string;\n  parent_id?: number | null;\n  level?: number;\n  tech_type?: string;\n  priority?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  tags?: string[] | null;\n  technical_details?: any;\n  benefits?: string[] | null;\n  applications?: string[] | null;\n  keywords?: string[] | null;\n  source_url?: string | null;\n  created_by?: string | null;\n  tech_principle?: string;\n  tech_value?: string;\n  tech_boundary?: string;\n  highlights?: string[];\n  evidence_measured?: string[];\n  evidence_certified?: string[];\n  evidence_comparison?: string[];\n  associated_car_models?: Array&lt;{\n    id?: number;\n    name: string;\n    brand: string;\n    type?: string;\n    car_model_id?: number;\n    relationship?: string;\n    notes?: string;\n  }&gt;;\n  associated_resources?: any[];\n}\n\n/**\n * 查找或创建技术分类\n */\nasync function findOrCreateCategory(\n  categoryId: number | undefined,\n  categoryName: string | undefined\n): Promise&lt;number | null&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n      }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 技术点相关类型定义\nimport { CarModel } from './carModel';\n\nexport interface TechPoint {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n  description: string;\n  features?: string; // 技术特性（从technology_versions迁移）\n  version?: string; // 版本号（从technology_versions迁移）\n  release_date?: string; // 发布日期（从technology_versions迁移）\n  technology_id?: number; // 关联的技术IP（从technology_versions迁移）\n  category_id: number;\n  parent_id?: number | null;\n  level: number;\n  tech_type: TechType; // 统一使用tech_type与后端保持一致\n  priority: TechPriority;\n  status: TechStatus;\n  tags?: string[];\n  technical_details?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  benefits?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  applications?: string[];\n  keywords?: string[];\n  source_url?: string;\n  created_by?: string;\n  tech_principle?: string; // 技术原理\n  tech_value?: string; // 价值\n  tech_boundary?: string; // 适用边界\n  highlights?: string[]; // 技术亮点列表\n  evidence_measured?: string[]; // 证据-实测列表\n  evidence_certified?: string[]; // 证据-认证列表\n  evidence_comparison?: string[]; // 证据-对比列表\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string;\n  category?: TechCategory;\n}\n\nexport interface TechCategory {\n  id: number;\n  name: string;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\nprivate async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n\n      }\n\n      // 准备技术点数据\n      const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\n        name: techPointDetail.name,\n        description: techPointDetail.description || null,\n        category_id: techPointDetail.category_id || null,\n        parent_id: techPointDetail.parent_id || null,\n        level: techPointDetail.level || 1,\n        tech_type: this.mapTechType(techPointDetail.tech_type),\n        priority: this.mapPriority(techPointDetail.priority),\n        status: this.mapStatus(techPointDetail.status),\n        tags: techPointDetail.tags || null,\n        technical_details: techPointDetail.technical_details || null,\n        benefits: techPointDetail.benefits || null,\n        applications: techPointDetail.applications || null,\n        keywords: techPointDetail.keywords || null,\n        source_url: techPointDetail.source_url || null,\n        created_by: techPointDetail.created_by || null,\n        // TPD2 同步相关字段\n        tpd_id: techPointDetail.id?.toString() || null,\n        car_models_info: carModelsInfo.length &gt; 0 ? carModelsInfo : undefined,\n        resources_info: resourcesInfo.length &gt; 0 ? resourcesInfo : undefined,\n        knowledge_info: knowledgeInfo || undefined\n      };\n\n      // 检查技术点是否已存在\n      // 优先通过 tpd_id 查找\n      let existing = null;\n      if (techPointData.tpd_id) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.tpd_id === techPointData.tpd_id);\n      }\n      \n      // 如果通过 tpd_id 找不到，尝试通过 ID 查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        existing = await techPointModel.findById(techPointDetail.id);\n      }\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = {\n          ...techPointData\n        };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# 技术点车型数据 API 传递验证文档\n\n## 概述\n\n本文档说明如何验证技术点关联车型数据是否可以通过 API 正确传递到本项目数据库。\n\n## 数据库变更\n\n已为 &#96;tech_points&#96; 表添加以下字段：\n\n- &#96;tpd_id&#96; (VARCHAR): TPD2 项目的原始 ID，用于同步锚点\n- &#96;car_models_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储车型信息数组\n- &#96;resources_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储资源信息数组\n- &#96;knowledge_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储知识点详情\n\n## 数据格式\n\n### CarModelInfo 接口\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface CarModelInfo {\n  id?: number;\n  name: string;\n  brand?: string;\n  brand_id?: number;\n  series?: string;\n  launch_date?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  application_status?: string;\n  implementation_date?: string;\n  notes?: string;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### ResourceInfo 接口\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface ResourceInfo {\n  type: 'pdf' | 'link' | 'image' | 'video' | 'document' | 'other';\n  name: string;\n  url?: string;\n  file_path?: string;\n  description?: string;\n  size?: number;\n  created_at?: string;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## API 使用示例\n\n### 1. 创建技术点（包含车型信息）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nPOST /api/v1/tech-points\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\n  \"name\": \"刀片电池技术\",\n  \"description\": \"磷酸铁锂刀片电池技术\",\n  \"tech_type\": \"technology\",\n  \"priority\": \"high\",\n  \"status\": \"active\",\n  \"tpd_id\": \"tpd_001\",\n  \"car_models_info\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"汉EV\",\n      \"brand\": \"比亚迪\",\n      \"brand_id\": 1,\n      \"series\": \"汉\",\n      \"launch_date\": \"2020-07-01\",\n      \"status\": \"active\",\n      \"application_status\": \"production\",\n      \"implementation_date\": \"2020-07-01\",\n      \"notes\": \"首款搭载刀片电池的车型\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"resources_info\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"pdf\",\n      \"name\": \"技术白皮书\",\n      \"url\": \"https://example.com/tech-whitepaper.pdf\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 更新技术点（更新车型信息）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nPUT /api/v1/tech-points/:id\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\n  \"car_models_info\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"汉EV\",",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\n\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\n\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\n\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\n\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\n\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\n\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    speech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    event_name VARCHAR(255),\n    event_date DATE,\n    speaker_notes TEXT,\n    slides_outline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储幻灯片大纲\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 推广策略与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    promotion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(promotion_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    press_release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_release_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(press_release_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speech_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    speech_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "export class TechPointController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步 TPD2 技术点数据\n   * POST /api/v1/tech-points/sync\n   */\n  async syncFromTPD(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      console.log('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n      \n      const result = await tpdSyncService.syncTechPoints();\n      \n      if (result.success) {\n        res.json({\n          success: true,\n          message: result.message,\n          data: result.stats\n        });\n      } else {\n        res.status(500).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: result.message,\n          data: result.stats\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('同步 TPD2 技术点数据失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/scripts/migrations/003_add_tpd_fields_to_tech_points.sql",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

        },
        "contents": "-- 迁移脚本：为 tech_points 表添加 TPD2 同步相关字段\n-- 执行日期：2025-12-08\n-- 说明：添加 tpd_id, car_models_info, resources_info 字段，实现单表管理\n\n-- SQLite 版本\n-- 注意：SQLite 不支持直接 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 添加多个列，需要逐个添加\n\n-- 1. 添加 tpd_id 字段（用于存储 TPD2 项目的原始 ID，作为同步锚点）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN tpd_id VARCHAR(100);\n\n-- 2. 添加 car_models_info 字段（JSON 格式存储车型信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN car_models_info TEXT;\n\n-- 3. 添加 resources_info 字段（JSON 格式存储资源信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN resources_info TEXT;\n\n-- 4. 添加 knowledge_info 字段（JSON 格式存储知识点详情，整合现有字段）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN knowledge_info TEXT;\n\n-- 5. 为 tpd_id 创建索引（用于快速查找和同步）\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n\n-- PostgreSQL 版本（如果需要）\n-- 注意：PostgreSQL 支持一次添加多个列\n/*\nALTER TABLE tech_points \n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tpd_id VARCHAR(100),\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS car_models_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS resources_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_info JSONB;\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n*/",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\n    implementation_date DATE,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 知识点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_query TEXT,\n    source_url TEXT,\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "/**\n * 导入单个技术点\n */\nasync function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 1. 处理技术分类\n    const categoryId = await findOrCreateCategory(\n      tpdTechPoint.category_id,\n      tpdTechPoint.category_name\n    );\n\n    // 2. 映射技术点类型\n    const techTypeMap: Record&lt;string, TechType&gt; = {\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE,\n      technology: TechType.TECHNOLOGY,\n      innovation: TechType.INNOVATION,\n      improvement: TechType.IMPROVEMENT,\n    };\n    const techType = techTypeMap[tpdTechPoint.tech_type || 'feature'] || TechType.FEATURE;\n\n    // 3. 映射优先级\n    const priorityMap: Record&lt;string, Priority&gt; = {\n      low: Priority.LOW,\n      medium: Priority.MEDIUM,\n      high: Priority.HIGH,\n      critical: Priority.CRITICAL,\n    };\n    const priority = priorityMap[tpdTechPoint.priority || 'medium'] || Priority.MEDIUM;\n\n    // 4. 映射状态\n    const statusMap: Record&lt;string, Status&gt; = {\n      active: Status.ACTIVE,\n      inactive: Status.INACTIVE,\n      draft: Status.DRAFT,\n      archived: Status.ARCHIVED,\n    };\n    const status = statusMap[tpdTechPoint.status || 'draft'] || Status.DRAFT;\n\n    // 5. 构建技术详情（合并多个字段）\n    const technicalDetails: any = {};\n    if (tpdTechPoint.tech_principle) {\n      technicalDetails.tech_principle = tpdTechPoint.tech_principle;\n    }\n    if (tpdTechPoint.tech_value) {\n      technicalDetails.tech_value = tpdTechPoint.tech_value;\n    }\n    if (tpdTechPoint.tech_boundary) {\n      technicalDetails.tech_boundary = tpdTechPoint.tech_boundary;\n    }\n    if (tpdTechPoint.highlights &amp;&amp; tpdTechPoint.highlights.length &gt; 0) {\n      technicalDetails.highlights = tpdTechPoint.highlights;\n    }\n    if (tpdTechPoint.evidence_measured &amp;&amp; tpdTechPoint.evidence_measured.length &gt; 0) {\n      technicalDetails.evidence_measured = tpdTechPoint.evidence_measured;\n    }\n    if (tpdTechPoint.evidence_certified &amp;&amp; tpdTechPoint.evidence_certified.length &gt; 0) {\n      technicalDetails.evidence_certified = tpdTechPoint.evidence_certified;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 导入单个技术点\n */\nasync function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 1. 处理技术分类\n    const categoryId = await findOrCreateCategory(\n      tpdTechPoint.category_id,\n      tpdTechPoint.category_name\n    );\n\n    // 2. 映射技术点类型\n    const techTypeMap: Record&lt;string, TechType&gt; = {\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE,\n      technology: TechType.TECHNOLOGY,\n      innovation: TechType.INNOVATION,\n      improvement: TechType.IMPROVEMENT,\n    };\n    const techType = techTypeMap[tpdTechPoint.tech_type || 'feature'] || TechType.FEATURE;\n\n    // 3. 映射优先级\n    const priorityMap: Record&lt;string, Priority&gt; = {\n      low: Priority.LOW,\n      medium: Priority.MEDIUM,\n      high: Priority.HIGH,\n      critical: Priority.CRITICAL,\n    };\n    const priority = priorityMap[tpdTechPoint.priority || 'medium'] || Priority.MEDIUM;\n\n    // 4. 映射状态\n    const statusMap: Record&lt;string, Status&gt; = {\n      active: Status.ACTIVE,\n      inactive: Status.INACTIVE,\n      draft: Status.DRAFT,\n      archived: Status.ARCHIVED,\n    };\n    const status = statusMap[tpdTechPoint.status || 'draft'] || Status.DRAFT;\n\n    // 5. 准备技术点数据（不合并技术知识点字段）\n    const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\n      name: tpdTechPoint.name,\n      description: tpdTechPoint.description || null,\n      category_id: categoryId || null,\n      parent_id: tpdTechPoint.parent_id || null,\n      level: tpdTechPoint.level || 1,\n      tech_type: techType,\n      priority: priority,\n      status: status,\n      tags: tpdTechPoint.tags || null,\n      technical_details: tpdTechPoint.technical_details || null,\n      benefits: tpdTechPoint.benefits || null,\n      applications: tpdTechPoint.applications || null,\n      keywords: tpdTechPoint.keywords || null,\n      source_url: tpdTechPoint.source_url || null,\n      created_by: tpdTechPoint.created_by || null,\n    };\n\n    // 7. 检查技术点是否已存在（通过名称）\n}",

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n\n    }\n    if (tpdTechPoint.evidence_certified &amp;&amp; tpdTechPoint.evidence_certified.length &gt; 0) {\n      technicalDetails.evidence_certified = tpdTechPoint.evidence_certified;\n    }\n    if (tpdTechPoint.evidence_comparison &amp;&amp; tpdTechPoint.evidence_comparison.length &gt; 0) {\n      technicalDetails.evidence_comparison = tpdTechPoint.evidence_comparison;\n    }\n    // 合并原有的technical_details\n    if (tpdTechPoint.technical_details) {\n      Object.assign(technicalDetails, tpdTechPoint.technical_details);\n    }\n\n    // 6. 准备技术点数据\n    const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\n      name: tpdTechPoint.name,\n      description: tpdTechPoint.description || undefined,\n      category_id: categoryId || undefined,\n      parent_id: tpdTechPoint.parent_id ?? undefined,\n      level: tpdTechPoint.level || 1,\n      tech_type: techType,\n      priority: priority,\n      status: status,\n      tags: tpdTechPoint.tags || undefined,\n      technical_details: Object.keys(technicalDetails).length &gt; 0 ? technicalDetails : undefined,\n      benefits: tpdTechPoint.benefits || undefined,\n      applications: tpdTechPoint.applications || undefined,\n      keywords: tpdTechPoint.keywords || undefined,\n      source_url: tpdTechPoint.source_url || undefined,\n      created_by: tpdTechPoint.created_by || undefined,\n    };\n\n    // 7. 检查技术点是否已存在（通过名称）\n    const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n    const existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === tpdTechPoint.name);\n\n    let techPointId: number;\n    if (existing) {\n      // 更新现有技术点\n      await techPointModel.update(existing.id, techPointData);\n}",

        "contents": "const TechPointForm: React.FC&lt;TechPointFormProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 根据品牌获取车型列表\n  const fetchCarModelsByBrand = async (brandId: number) =&gt; {\n    setModelsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const response = await carModelService.getByBrand(brandId);\n      setCarModels(response.data || []);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"获取车型列表失败:\", error);\n      setCarModels([]);\n    } finally {\n      setModelsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 根据车型获取车系列表\n  const fetchCarSeriesByModel = async (modelId: number) =&gt; {\n    setSeriesLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const response = await carSeriesService.getByModel(modelId);\n      setCarSeries(response.data || []);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"获取车系列表失败:\", error);\n      setCarSeries([]);\n    } finally {\n      setSeriesLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    fetchCategories();\n    fetchBrands();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (selectedBrandId) {\n      fetchCarModelsByBrand(selectedBrandId);\n      setCarSeries([]);\n      setSelectedModelId(null);\n    } else {\n      setCarModels([]);\n      setCarSeries([]);\n      setSelectedModelId(null);\n    }\n  }, [selectedBrandId]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (selectedModelId) {\n      fetchCarSeriesByModel(selectedModelId);\n    } else {\n      setCarSeries([]);\n    }\n  }, [selectedModelId]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (techPoint) {\n      setFormData({\n        name: techPoint.name,\n        description: techPoint.description,\n        category_id: techPoint.category_id,\n        type: techPoint.type,\n        priority: techPoint.priority,\n        status: techPoint.status,\n      });\n    }\n  }, [techPoint]);\n\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =&gt; {\n;\n;",

        "contents": "-- 迁移脚本：为 tech_points 表添加 TPD2 同步相关字段\n-- 执行日期：2025-12-08\n-- 说明：添加 tpd_id, car_models_info, resources_info 字段，实现单表管理\n\n-- SQLite 版本\n-- 注意：SQLite 不支持直接 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 添加多个列，需要逐个添加\n\n-- 1. 添加 tpd_id 字段（用于存储 TPD2 项目的原始 ID，作为同步锚点）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN tpd_id VARCHAR(100);\n\n-- 2. 添加 car_models_info 字段（JSON 格式存储车型信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN car_models_info TEXT;\n\n-- 3. 添加 resources_info 字段（JSON 格式存储资源信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN resources_info TEXT;\n\n-- 4. 添加 knowledge_info 字段（JSON 格式存储知识点详情，整合现有字段）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN knowledge_info TEXT;\n\n-- 5. 为 tpd_id 创建索引（用于快速查找和同步）\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n\n-- PostgreSQL 版本（如果需要）\n-- 注意：PostgreSQL 支持一次添加多个列\n/*\nALTER TABLE tech_points \n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tpd_id VARCHAR(100),\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS car_models_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS resources_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_info JSONB;\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n*/",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/scripts/README-TECH-POINT-CAR-MODELS-API.md",

          "startPosition": {

          "endPosition": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "{\n  \"car_models_info\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"汉EV\",\n      \"brand\": \"比亚迪\",\n      \"status\": \"active\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"唐EV\",\n      \"brand\": \"比亚迪\",\n      \"status\": \"active\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 获取技术点（包含车型信息）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nGET /api/v1/tech-points/:id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n响应示例：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"data\": {\n    \"id\": 1,\n    \"name\": \"刀片电池技术\",\n    \"tpd_id\": \"tpd_001\",\n    \"car_models_info\": [\n      {\n        \"name\": \"汉EV\",\n        \"brand\": \"比亚迪\",\n        \"status\": \"active\"\n      }\n    ],\n    \"resources_info\": [...],\n    ...\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 运行测试脚本\n\n### 执行数据库迁移\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd backend\nnpm run ts-node src/scripts/migrations/003_add_tpd_fields_to_tech_points.ts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 运行验证测试\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd backend\nnpm run ts-node src/scripts/test-tech-point-car-models-api.ts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n测试脚本将验证：\n\n1. ✅ 创建技术点时包含车型信息\n2. ✅ 通过 tpd_id 查找技术点\n3. ✅ 更新技术点的车型信息\n4. ✅ 数据正确保存到数据库\n5. ✅ 数据正确从数据库读取\n\n## TPD2 同步\n\n当从 TPD2 同步技术点数据时，&#96;TPDSyncService&#96; 会自动：\n\n1. 从 TPD2 API 获取技术点详情（包含 &#96;carModels&#96; 数据）\n2. 将 &#96;carModels&#96; 转换为 &#96;CarModelInfo[]&#96; 格式\n3. 保存到 &#96;car_models_info&#96; JSON 字段\n4. 使用 &#96;tpd_id&#96; 作为同步锚点，避免重复创建\n\n### 同步 API\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nPOST /api/v1/tech-points/sync\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 注意事项\n\n1. **数据格式**: 确保传入的 &#96;car_models_info&#96; 是有效的 JSON 数组\n2. **字段验证**: &#96;name&#96; 字段是必需的，其他字段可选\n3. **tpd_id**: 用于 TPD2 同步，建议在创建时设置\n4. **向后兼容**: 现有的关联表 &#96;tech_point_car_models&#96; 仍然保留，但新数据优先使用 JSON 字段\n\n## 故障排查\n\n### 问题：车型数据没有保存\n\n**检查项：**\n1. 确认数据库迁移已执行\n2. 检查 API 请求的 Content-Type 是否为 &#96;application/json&#96;\n3. 查看后端日志是否有错误信息",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "## 运行测试脚本",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "### 执行数据库迁移",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "cd backend",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run ts-node src/scripts/migrations/003_add_tpd_fields_to_tech_points.ts",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "### 运行验证测试",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "cd backend",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run ts-node src/scripts/test-tech-point-car-models-api.ts",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "测试脚本将验证：",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "1. ✅ 创建技术点时包含车型信息",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "2. ✅ 通过 tpd_id 查找技术点",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "3. ✅ 更新技术点的车型信息",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "4. ✅ 数据正确保存到数据库",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "5. ✅ 数据正确从数据库读取",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "## TPD2 同步",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "当从 TPD2 同步技术点数据时，&#96;TPDSyncService&#96; 会自动：",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "1. 从 TPD2 API 获取技术点详情（包含 &#96;carModels&#96; 数据）",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "2. 将 &#96;carModels&#96; 转换为 &#96;CarModelInfo[]&#96; 格式",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "3. 保存到 &#96;car_models_info&#96; JSON 字段",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "4. 使用 &#96;tpd_id&#96; 作为同步锚点，避免重复创建",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "### 同步 API",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "POST /api/v1/tech-points/sync",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "## 注意事项",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **数据格式**: 确保传入的 &#96;car_models_info&#96; 是有效的 JSON 数组",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **字段验证**: &#96;name&#96; 字段是必需的，其他字段可选",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **tpd_id**: 用于 TPD2 同步，建议在创建时设置",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **向后兼容**: 现有的关联表 &#96;tech_point_car_models&#96; 仍然保留，但新数据优先使用 JSON 字段",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "## 故障排查",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "### 问题：车型数据没有保存",
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "**检查项：**",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "1. 确认数据库迁移已执行",
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "text": "2. 检查 API 请求的 Content-Type 是否为 &#96;application/json&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "3. 查看后端日志是否有错误信息",
            "lineNumber": 190
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4106290936470032
    },

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\nconst ;\n\n    let techPointId: number;\n    if (existing) {\n      // 更新现有技术点\n      await techPointModel.update(existing.id, techPointData);\n      techPointId = existing.id;\n      console.log(&#96;  ✅ 更新技术点: ${tpdTechPoint.name} (ID: ${techPointId})&#96;);\n    } else {\n      // 创建新技术点\n      const newTechPoint = await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n      techPointId = newTechPoint.id;\n      console.log(&#96;  ✅ 创建技术点: ${tpdTechPoint.name} (ID: ${techPointId})&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 8. 处理关联车型\n    if (tpdTechPoint.associated_car_models &amp;&amp; tpdTechPoint.associated_car_models.length &gt; 0) {\n      for (const carModelData of tpdTechPoint.associated_car_models) {\n        try {\n          // 验证车型数据：必须有名称\n          if (!carModelData.name || carModelData.name.trim() === '') {\n            console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  跳过无效车型数据: 缺少车型名称&#96;, carModelData);\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          // 验证品牌数据：如果品牌为空或无效，记录警告但不创建品牌\n          const brandName = carModelData.brand?.trim();\n          if (!brandName || brandName === '') {\n            console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  车型 ${carModelData.name} 缺少品牌信息，将不关联品牌&#96;, carModelData);\n            // 如果品牌为空，跳过该车型或使用默认处理\n            // 这里选择跳过，因为无法创建没有品牌的车型\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          // 处理车型ID：即使有car_model_id，也要验证品牌和名称是否匹配\n          let carModelId: number;\n          if (carModelData.car_model_id) {\n            const existingCarModel = await carModelModel.findById(carModelData.car_model_id);\n}",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步单个技术点\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{created: boolean}&gt;} 返回是否为新创建\n   */\n  private async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 获取技术点详情（包含关联数据）\n      const detailResponse = await axios.get(\n        &#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points/${tpdTechPoint.id}&#96;,\n        {\n          params: {\n            includeAssociations: true,\n          },\n          timeout: 30000,\n        }\n      );\n\n      if (detailResponse.data.code !== 200 || !detailResponse.data.data) {\n        throw new Error('获取技术点详情失败');\n      }\n\n      const techPointDetail = detailResponse.data.data;\n\n      // 转换车型数据为 CarModelInfo 格式\n      const carModelsInfo: CarModelInfo[] = [];\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\n        for (const carModel of techPointDetail.carModels) {\n          carModelsInfo.push({\n            id: carModel.id || carModel.car_model_id,\n            name: carModel.name || carModel.model_name || '',\n            brand: carModel.brand || carModel.brand_name,\n            brand_id: carModel.brand_id,\n            series: carModel.series || carModel.series_name,\n            launch_date: carModel.launch_date || carModel.launch_year?.toString(),\n            status: carModel.status,\n            application_status: carModel.application_status || carModel.status,\n            implementation_date: carModel.implementation_date,\n            notes: carModel.notes || carModel.relationship\n          });\n        }\n        logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${carModelsInfo.length} 个车型，已转换为 JSON 格式&#96;);\n      }\n\n      // 转换资源数据为 ResourceInfo 格式\n      const resourcesInfo: ResourceInfo[] = [];\n      if (techPointDetail.resources &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.resources)) {\n        for (const resource of techPointDetail.resources)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\nprivate async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n\n      }\n\n      // 准备技术点数据\n      const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\n        name: techPointDetail.name,\n        description: techPointDetail.description || null,\n        category_id: techPointDetail.category_id || null,\n        parent_id: techPointDetail.parent_id || null,\n        level: techPointDetail.level || 1,\n        tech_type: this.mapTechType(techPointDetail.tech_type),\n        priority: this.mapPriority(techPointDetail.priority),\n        status: this.mapStatus(techPointDetail.status),\n        tags: techPointDetail.tags || null,\n        technical_details: techPointDetail.technical_details || null,\n        benefits: techPointDetail.benefits || null,\n        applications: techPointDetail.applications || null,\n        keywords: techPointDetail.keywords || null,\n        source_url: techPointDetail.source_url || null,\n        created_by: techPointDetail.created_by || null,\n        // TPD2 同步相关字段\n        tpd_id: techPointDetail.id?.toString() || null,\n        car_models_info: carModelsInfo.length &gt; 0 ? carModelsInfo : undefined,\n        resources_info: resourcesInfo.length &gt; 0 ? resourcesInfo : undefined,\n        knowledge_info: knowledgeInfo || undefined\n      };\n\n      // 检查技术点是否已存在\n      // 优先通过 tpd_id 查找\n      let existing = null;\n      if (techPointData.tpd_id) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.tpd_id === techPointData.tpd_id);\n      }\n      \n      // 如果通过 tpd_id 找不到，尝试通过 ID 查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        existing = await techPointModel.findById(techPointDetail.id);\n      }\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = {\n          ...techPointData\n        };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n\n          let carModelId: number;\n          if (carModelData.car_model_id) {\n            const existingCarModel = await carModelModel.findById(carModelData.car_model_id);\n            if (existingCarModel) {\n              // 验证已存在的车型是否与TPD2数据匹配\n              // 获取车型的品牌信息\n              const brandCheckSql = 'SELECT b.name as brand_name FROM brands b WHERE b.id = ?';\n              const brandCheckResult = await db.query(brandCheckSql, [existingCarModel.brand_id]);\n              const existingBrandName = Array.isArray(brandCheckResult) &amp;&amp; brandCheckResult.length &gt; 0 \n                ?         "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n {\n      for (const carModelData of tpdTechPoint.associated_car_models) {\n        try {\n          // 如果已有car_model_id，直接使用\n          let carModelId: number;\n          if (carModelData.car_model_id) {\n            const existingCarModel = await carModelModel.findById(carModelData.car_model_id);\n            if (existingCarModel) {\n              carModelId = existingCarModel.id;\n            } else {\n              // 如果ID不存在，通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n              carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n                carModelData.brand,\n                carModelData.name,\n                carModelData.type\n              );\n            }\n          } else {\n            // 通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n            carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n              carModelData.brand,\n              carModelData.name,\n              carModelData.type\n            );\n          }\n\n          // 关联车型到技术点\n          try {\n            await techPointModel.associateCarModel(\n              techPointId,\n              carModelId,\n              'planned', // 默认状态\n              null,\n              carModelData.notes || carModelData.relationship || null\n            );\n            console.log(&#96;    ✅ 关联车型: ${carModelData.brand} ${carModelData.name}&#96;);\n          } catch (error: any) {\n            // 如果已存在关联，忽略错误\n            if (!error.message?.includes('已关联') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('UNIQUE')) {\n              console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  关联车型失败: ${carModelData.brand} ${carModelData.name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  处理车型失败: ${carModelData.name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 9. 处理技术知识点（创建独立的知识点记录）\n    const knowledgePointService = new KnowledgePointService();\n    let knowledgePointCount = 0;\n\n    // 技术原理\n    if\n}",

        "contents": "const TechPointLibraryPage: React.FC = \nconst loadTechnologies = async () =&gt; {\n\n  }, []);\n\n  const loadTechPoints = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const params: any = {\n        page: currentPage,\n        pageSize,\n      };\n      \n      if (searchKeyword) {\n        params.keyword = searchKeyword;\n      }\n      if (categoryFilter) {\n        params.category_id = categoryFilter;\n      }\n      if (typeFilter) {\n        params.tech_type = typeFilter;\n      }\n      if (priorityFilter) {\n        params.priority = priorityFilter;\n      }\n      if (statusFilter) {\n        params.status = statusFilter;\n      }\n\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints(params);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        const data = Array.isArray(response.data.data) \n          ? response.data.data \n          : response.data.items || [];\n        setTechPoints(data);\n        setTotal(response.data.total || 0);\n        // 如果当前页没有数据且不是第一页，跳转到第一页\n        if (data.length === 0 &amp;&amp; currentPage &gt; 1) {\n          setCurrentPage(1);\n        }\n      } else {\n        message.error(response.error || '加载技术点失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载技术点失败:', error);\n      message.error('加载技术点失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [currentPage, pageSize, searchKeyword, categoryFilter, typeFilter, priorityFilter, statusFilter]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadTechCategories();\n    loadTechnologies();\n  }, [loadTechCategories, loadTechnologies]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadTechPoints();\n  }, [loadTechPoints]);\n\n  const handleCreate = () =&gt; {\n    setSelectedTechPoint(null);\n    setEditModalVisible(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleEdit = (techPoint: TechPoint) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedTechPoint(techPoint);\n    setEditModalVisible(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (id: number) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const TechPointLibraryPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const handleDelete = async (id: number) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.deleteTechPoint(id);\n      if (response.success) {\n        message.success('删除成功');\n        // 重新加载数据，确保与后端同步（后端是软删除，状态变为archived）\n        await loadTechPoints();\n      } else {\n        message.error(response.error || '删除失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除技术点失败:', error);\n      message.error('删除失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleViewDetail = (techPoint: TechPoint, event?: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {\n    if (isSelectMode) {\n      // 选择模式下，点击行切换选中状态\n      // 如果点击的是复选框，不处理（由复选框自己处理）\n      if (event?.target instanceof HTMLElement &amp;&amp; event.target.closest('.ant-checkbox-wrapper')) {\n        return;\n      }\n      toggleSelectTechPoint(techPoint.id);\n    } else {\n      navigate(&#96;/tech-point-library/${techPoint.id}&#96;, {\n        state: { from: '/tech-point-library' }\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const toggleSelectTechPoint = (techPointId: number) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedTechPointIds(prev =&gt; \n      prev.includes(techPointId)\n        ? prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== techPointId)\n        : [...prev, techPointId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const handleSelectAll = (checked: boolean) =&gt; {\n    if (checked) {\n      setSelectedTechPointIds(techPoints.map(tp =&gt; tp.id));\n    } else {\n      setSelectedTechPointIds([]);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleConfirmSelection = () =&gt; {\n    if (selectedTechPointIds.length === 0) {\n      message.warning('请至少选择一个技术点');\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    // 将选中的技术点ID传回\n    const separator = returnUrl.includes('?') ? 已完成对 `TechPointEditModal` 的更新，使其与 TPD2 项目的技术点管理对齐。主要更改如下：

## 已完成的更新

### 1. 添加了车型信息选择器
- 添加了品牌、车型、车系三级联动选择器
- 实现了级联加载（选择品牌后加载车型，选择车型后加载车系）
- 添加了加载状态提示

### 2. 确保所有字段正确显示
- 技术原理 (`tech_principle`) - 已存在并正确显示
- 价值 (`tech_value`) - 已存在并正确显示
- 适用边界 (`tech_boundary`) - 已存在并正确显示
- 所有证据字段（实测、认证、对比）已存在

### 3. 优化了表单布局
- 将 Modal 宽度从 800px 增加到 900px
- 添加了滚动支持，适应更多内容
- 使用分隔线组织表单结构

### 4. 添加了必要的服务和类型导入
- 导入了 `brandService`、`carModelService`、`carSeriesService`
- 导入了相关的类型定义（`Brand`、`CarModel`、`CarSeries`）

### 5. 车型关联管理提示
- 对于已创建的技术点，显示提示信息，引导用户在详情页面管理关联车型

现在编辑技术点表单已包含所有必要字段，包括车型信息选择器，与 TPD2 项目的技术点管理功能对齐。所有字段（技术原理、价值、适用边界等）都会正确显示和保存。

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的所有内容\n   */\n  async getAssociatedContent(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;{\n    packagingMaterials: any[];\n    promotionStrategies: any[];\n    pressReleases: any[];\n    speeches: any[];\n  }&gt; {\n    // 初始化返回结果\n    const result = {\n      packagingMaterials: [] as any[],\n      promotionStrategies: [] as any[],\n      pressReleases: [] as any[],\n      speeches: [] as any[]\n    };\n\n    try {\n    // 获取技术包装材料\n    const packagingSql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM tech_packaging_materials \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? \n      ORDER BY created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n      try {\n        const packagingResult = await this.db.query(packagingSql, [techPointId]);\n        result.packagingMaterials = Array.isArray(packagingResult) ? packagingResult : [];\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 表不存在或其他错误，返回空数组\n        if (!error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n          console.warn('获取技术包装材料失败:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 忽略错误\n    }\n\n    try {\n    // 获取推广策略\n    const promotionSql = &#96;\n      SELECT ts.*, pt.weight \n      FROM tech_promotion_strategies ts\n      JOIN promotion_tech_points pt ON ts.id = pt.promotion_id\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n      try {\n        const promotionResult = await this.db.query(promotionSql, [techPointId]);\n        result.promotionStrategies = Array.isArray(promotionResult) ? promotionResult : [];\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        if (!error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n          console.warn('获取推广策略失败:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 忽略错误\n    }\n\n    try {\n    // 获取通稿\n    const pressSql = &#96;\n      SELECT pr.*, pt.weight \n      FROM tech_press_releases pr\n      JOIN press_tech_points pt ON pr.id = pt.press_release_id\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarSeriesModel {\nasync getTechPoints(carSeriesId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (testRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('硬编码查询成功，现在测试参数化查询');\n        \n        const sql = &#96;\n          SELECT \n            tp.id,\n            tp.name,\n            tp.description,\n            tp.tech_type,\n            tp.priority,\n            tp.status,\n            tp.tags,\n            tp.technical_details,\n            tp.benefits,\n            tp.applications,\n            tp.keywords,\n            tp.source_url,\n            tp.created_at,\n            tp.updated_at,\n            tpcm.application_status,\n            tpcm.implementation_date,\n            tpcm.notes as association_notes\n          FROM tech_points tp\n          INNER JOIN tech_point_car_models tpcm ON tp.id = tpcm.tech_point_id\n          INNER JOIN car_models cm ON tpcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n          INNER JOIN car_series cs ON cs.model_id = cm.id\n          WHERE cs.id = ?\n          ORDER BY tp.priority DESC, tp.name ASC\n        &#96;;\n        \n        console.log('执行参数化SQL查询:', sql);\n        console.log('查询参数:', [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        const rows = await this.db.query(sql, [carSeriesId]);\n        \n        console.log('参数化查询结果行数:', rows.length);\n        console.log('参数化查询结果:', rows);\n        \n        return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; ({\n          ...row,\n          tags: row.tags ? JSON.parse(row.benefits) : [],\n          applications: row.applications ? JSON.parse(row.applications) : [],\n          keywords: row.keywords ?         "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\nprivate async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n\n      }\n\n      // 准备技术点数据\n      const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\n        name: techPointDetail.name,\n        description: techPointDetail.description || null,\n        category_id: techPointDetail.category_id || null,\n        parent_id: techPointDetail.parent_id || null,\n        level: techPointDetail.level || 1,\n        tech_type: this.mapTechType(techPointDetail.tech_type),\n        priority: this.mapPriority(techPointDetail.priority),\n        status: this.mapStatus(techPointDetail.status),\n        tags: techPointDetail.tags || null,\n        technical_details: techPointDetail.technical_details || null,\n        benefits: techPointDetail.benefits || null,\n        applications: techPointDetail.applications || null,\n        keywords: techPointDetail.keywords || null,\n        source_url: techPointDetail.source_url || null,\n        created_by: techPointDetail.created_by || null,\n        // TPD2 同步相关字段\n        tpd_id: techPointDetail.id?.toString() || null,\n        car_models_info: carModelsInfo.length &gt; 0 ? carModelsInfo : undefined,\n        resources_info: resourcesInfo.length &gt; 0 ? resourcesInfo : undefined,\n        knowledge_info: knowledgeInfo || undefined\n      };\n\n      // 检查技术点是否已存在\n      // 优先通过 tpd_id 查找\n      let existing = null;\n      if (techPointData.tpd_id) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.tpd_id === techPointData.tpd_id);\n      }\n      \n      // 如果通过 tpd_id 找不到，尝试通过 ID 查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        existing = await techPointModel.findById(techPointDetail.id);\n      }\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = {\n          ...techPointData\n        };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\nasync getAssociatedContent(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;{\n    packagingMaterials: any[];\n    promotionStrategies: any[];\n    pressReleases: any[];\n    speeches: any[];\n  }&gt; {\n\n\n    try {\n    // 获取通稿\n    const pressSql = &#96;\n      SELECT pr.*, pt.weight \n      FROM tech_press_releases pr\n      JOIN press_tech_points pt ON pr.id = pt.press_release_id\n      WHERE pt.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n      try {\n        const pressResult = await this.db.query(pressSql, [techPointId]);\n        result.pressReleases = Array.isArray(pressResult) ? pressResult : [];\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        if (!error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n          console.warn('获取通稿失败:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 忽略错误\n    }\n\n    try {\n    // 获取演讲稿\n    const speechSql = &#96;\n      SELECT sp.*, st.weight \n      FROM tech_speeches sp\n      JOIN speech_tech_points st ON sp.id = st.speech_id\n      WHERE st.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n      try {\n        const speechResult = await this.db.query(speechSql, [techPointId]);\n        result.speeches = Array.isArray(speechResult) ? speechResult : [];\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        if (!error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n          console.warn('获取演讲稿失败:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 忽略错误\n    }\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\n   */\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    speech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    event_name VARCHAR(255),\n    event_date DATE,\n    speaker_notes TEXT,\n    slides_outline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储幻灯片大纲\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 推广策略与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    promotion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(promotion_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    press_release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_release_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(press_release_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speech_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    speech_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "range": {

        },
        "contents": "-- 迁移脚本：为 tech_points 表添加 TPD2 同步相关字段\n-- 执行日期：2025-12-08\n-- 说明：添加 tpd_id, car_models_info, resources_info 字段，实现单表管理\n\n-- SQLite 版本\n-- 注意：SQLite 不支持直接 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 添加多个列，需要逐个添加\n\n-- 1. 添加 tpd_id 字段（用于存储 TPD2 项目的原始 ID，作为同步锚点）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN tpd_id VARCHAR(100);\n\n-- 2. 添加 car_models_info 字段（JSON 格式存储车型信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN car_models_info TEXT;\n\n-- 3. 添加 resources_info 字段（JSON 格式存储资源信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN resources_info TEXT;\n\n-- 4. 添加 knowledge_info 字段（JSON 格式存储知识点详情，整合现有字段）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN knowledge_info TEXT;\n\n-- 5. 为 tpd_id 创建索引（用于快速查找和同步）\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n\n-- PostgreSQL 版本（如果需要）\n-- 注意：PostgreSQL 支持一次添加多个列\n/*\nALTER TABLE tech_points \n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tpd_id VARCHAR(100),\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS car_models_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS resources_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_info JSONB;\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n*/",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "async function createTechTables(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  if (await tableExists('tech_points')) {\n    console.log('✅ tech_points 表已存在');\n  } else {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_points (\n        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n        name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n        description TEXT,\n        category_id INTEGER,\n        parent_id INTEGER,\n        level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n        tech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n        priority VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',\n        status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n        tags TEXT,\n        technical_details TEXT,\n        benefits TEXT,\n        applications TEXT,\n        keywords TEXT,\n        source_url VARCHAR(500),\n        created_by VARCHAR(255),\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n        FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n      );\n      \n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_category_id ON tech_points(category_id);\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_parent_id ON tech_points(parent_id);\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_status ON tech_points(status);\n    &#96;;\n    await executeSQL(sql);\n    console.log('✅ tech_points 表创建成功');\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 创建页面工具配置表\n */\nasync function createPageToolConfigTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  if\n}",

        "contents": ");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 插入示例数据\n-- 技术分类示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\n\n-- 车型车系示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\n\n-- 技术点示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据",

        "contents": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\n\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\n\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\n\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\n\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\n\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\n\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |",

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n\n    let knowledgePointCount = 0;\n\n    // 技术原理\n    if (tpdTechPoint.tech_principle) {\n      try {\n        await knowledgePointService.createKnowledgePoint({\n          tech_point_id: techPointId,\n          title: '技术原理',\n          content: tpdTechPoint.tech_principle,\n          knowledge_type: KnowledgeType.PRINCIPLE,\n          difficulty_level: DifficultyLevel.MEDIUM,\n          status: Status.ACTIVE,\n          created_by: tpdTechPoint.created_by || null,\n        });\n        knowledgePointCount++;\n        console.log(&#96;    ✅ 创建知识点: 技术原理&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  创建知识点\"技术原理\"失败: ${error.message}&#96;);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 价值\n    if (tpdTechPoint.tech_value) {\n      try {\n        await knowledgePointService.createKnowledgePoint({\n          tech_point_id: techPointId,\n          title: '价值',\n          content: tpdTechPoint.tech_value,\n          knowledge_type: KnowledgeType.APPLICATION,\n          difficulty_level: DifficultyLevel.MEDIUM,\n          status: Status.ACTIVE,\n          created_by: tpdTechPoint.created_by || null,\n        });\n        knowledgePointCount++;\n        console.log(&#96;    ✅ 创建知识点: 适用边界&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  创建知识点\"适用边界\"失败: ${error.message}&#96;);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 技术亮点（数组，每个亮点创建一个知识点）\n    if\n}",

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n\n    let knowledgePointCount = 0;\n\n    // 技术原理\n    if (tpdTechPoint.tech_principle) {\n      try {\n        await knowledgePointService.createKnowledgePoint({\n          tech_point_id: techPointId,\n          title: '技术原理',\n          content: tpdTechPoint.tech_principle,\n          knowledge_type: KnowledgeType.PRINCIPLE,\n          difficulty_level: DifficultyLevel.MEDIUM,\n          status: Status.ACTIVE,\n          created_by: tpdTechPoint.created_by || undefined,\n        });\n        knowledgePointCount++;\n        console.log(&#96;    ✅ 创建知识点: 技术原理&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  创建知识点\"技术原理\"失败: ${error.message}&#96;);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 价值\n    if (tpdTechPoint.tech_value) {\n      try {\n        await knowledgePointService.createKnowledgePoint({\n          tech_point_id: techPointId,\n          title: '价值',\n          content: tpdTechPoint.tech_value,\n          knowledge_type: KnowledgeType.APPLICATION,\n          difficulty_level: DifficultyLevel.MEDIUM,\n          status: Status.ACTIVE,\n          created_by: tpdTechPoint.created_by || undefined,\n        });\n        knowledgePointCount++;\n        console.log(&#96;         "contents": "/**\n * 从TPD2项目API导入所有技术点数据\n * 一次性导入所有技术点及其关联数据\n */\n\nimport axios from 'axios';\nimport { DatabaseManager, db } from '../config/database';\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel, carModelModel } from '../models';\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority, KnowledgeType, DifficultyLevel, CreateKnowledgePointDTO } from '../types/database';\nimport { KnowledgePointService } from '../services/knowledgePointService';\n\ninterface TPD2TechPoint {\n  id?: number;\n  name: string;\n  description?: string;\n  category_id?: number;\n  category_name?: string;\n  parent_id?: number | null;\n  level?: number;\n  tech_type?: string;\n  priority?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  tags?: string[] | null;\n  technical_details?: any;\n  benefits?: string[] | null;\n  applications?: string[] | null;\n  keywords?: string[] | null;\n  source_url?: string | null;\n  created_by?: string | null;\n  tech_principle?: string;\n  tech_value?: string;\n  tech_boundary?: string;\n  highlights?: string[];\n  evidence_measured?: string[];\n  evidence_certified?: string[];\n  evidence_comparison?: string[];\n  associated_car_models?: Array&lt;{\n    id?: number;\n    name: string;\n    brand: string;\n    type?: string;\n    car_model_id?: number;\n    relationship?: string;\n    notes?: string;\n  }&gt;;\n  associated_resources?: any[];\n}\n\n/**\n * 查找或创建技术分类\n */\nasync function findOrCreateCategory(\n  categoryId: number | undefined,\n  categoryName: string | undefined\n): Promise&lt;number | null&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "async function createKnowledgePointsTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n\n    if (tableExists) {\n      console.log('✅ knowledge_points 表已存在');\n      \n      // 检查是否有 tech_point_id 字段\n      let hasTechPointId = false;\n      if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n        const tableInfo = await db.query('PRAGMA table_info(knowledge_points)');\n        const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n        hasTechPointId = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === 'tech_point_id');\n      } else {\n        const checkResult = await db.query(&#96;\n          SELECT EXISTS (\n            SELECT FROM information_schema.columns \n            WHERE table_schema = 'public' \n            AND table_name = 'knowledge_points' \n            AND column_name = 'tech_point_id'\n          )\n        &#96;);\n        hasTechPointId = checkResult[0]?.exists === true;\n      }\n\n      if (!hasTechPointId) {\n        console.log('📝 添加 tech_point_id 字段...');\n        await db.query(&#96;\n          ALTER TABLE knowledge_points \n          ADD COLUMN tech_point_id INTEGER\n        &#96;);\n        console.log('✅ 已添加 tech_point_id 字段');\n      }\n\n      // 检查其他必要字段\n      const requiredFields = [\n        { name: 'knowledge_type', type: 'TEXT', default: \"'concept'\" },\n        { name: 'difficulty_level', type: 'TEXT', default: \"'medium'\" },\n        { name: 'prerequisites', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n        { name: 'learning_objectives', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n        { name: 'examples', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n        { name: 'references', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n      ];\n\n      for (const field of requiredFields)\n}",

        "contents": "| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\n| application_status | VARCHAR(50) | 应用状态 |\n| implementation_date | DATE | 实施日期 |\n| notes | TEXT | 备注 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n**唯一约束**：(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n\n### 2.3 第三层：AI内容生成层\n\n#### 2.3.1 知识点表 (knowledge_points)\n\n存储从AI搜索等来源获取的知识点。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| title | TEXT | 标题 |\n| content | TEXT | 内容 |\n| source_query | TEXT | 来源查询 |\n| source_url | TEXT | 来源URL |\n| source_type | TEXT | 来源类型：ai_search/manual/import |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON格式的元数据 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON格式的标签 |\n| relevance_score | REAL | 相关度分数 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| dify_task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\n| ai_search_session_id | TEXT | AI搜索会话ID |\n| created_by | INTEGER | 创建者ID |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.3.2 技术包装材料表 (tech_packaging_materials)\n\n存储AI生成的技术包装材料。\n\n#### 2.3.3 技术推广策略表 (tech_promotion_strategies)\n\n存储AI生成的技术推广策略。\n\n#### 2.3.4 技术通稿表 (tech_press_releases)\n\n存储AI生成的技术通稿。\n\n#### 2.3.5 技术演讲稿表 (tech_speeches)\n\n存储AI生成的技术演讲稿。\n\n### 2.4 第四层：工作流与对话层\n\n#### 2.4.1 Agent工作流表 (agent_workflows)\n\n存储Agent工作流定义。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\n| name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| version | TEXT | 版本号（默认'1.0.0'） |\n| nodes | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点列表 |\n| edges | TEXT | JSON字符串，连接边列表 |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON字符串，元数据 |\n| published | INTEGER | 是否已发布（0/1） |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |",

        "contents": "async function addTechPointIdToKnowledgePoints(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n\n    // 添加字段\n    if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n      // SQLite 不支持直接添加 NOT NULL 字段，先添加可空字段\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        ALTER TABLE knowledge_points \n        ADD COLUMN tech_point_id INTEGER\n      &#96;);\n      \n      // 添加外键约束（SQLite 需要重新创建表）\n      console.log('⚠️  SQLite 需要手动添加外键约束');\n      console.log('   建议使用以下 SQL 重新创建表或手动添加外键');\n    } else {\n      // PostgreSQL\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        ALTER TABLE knowledge_points \n        ADD COLUMN tech_point_id INTEGER,\n        ADD CONSTRAINT fk_knowledge_points_tech_point \n        FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n      &#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 添加索引\n    try {\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_points_tech_point_id \n        ON knowledge_points(tech_point_id)\n      &#96;);\n      console.log('✅ 已添加索引');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.warn('⚠️  添加索引失败:', error.message);\n    }\n\n    // 添加其他可能缺失的字段（根据 KnowledgePointService 需要的字段）\n    const requiredFields = [\n      { name: 'knowledge_type', type: 'TEXT', default: \"'concept'\" },\n      { name: 'difficulty_level', type: 'TEXT', default: \"'medium'\" },\n      { name: 'prerequisites', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n      { name: 'learning_objectives', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n      { name: 'examples', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n      { name: 'references', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n    ];\n\n    for (const field of requiredFields)\n}",

        "contents": "# 技术点车型数据 API 传递验证文档\n\n## 概述\n\n本文档说明如何验证技术点关联车型数据是否可以通过 API 正确传递到本项目数据库。\n\n## 数据库变更\n\n已为 &#96;tech_points&#96; 表添加以下字段：\n\n- &#96;tpd_id&#96; (VARCHAR): TPD2 项目的原始 ID，用于同步锚点\n- &#96;car_models_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储车型信息数组\n- &#96;resources_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储资源信息数组\n- &#96;knowledge_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储知识点详情\n\n## 数据格式\n\n### CarModelInfo 接口\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface CarModelInfo {\n  id?: number;\n  name: string;\n  brand?: string;\n  brand_id?: number;\n  series?: string;\n  launch_date?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  application_status?: string;\n  implementation_date?: string;\n  notes?: string;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### ResourceInfo 接口\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface ResourceInfo {\n  type: 'pdf' | 'link' | 'image' | 'video' | 'document' | 'other';\n  name: string;\n  url?: string;\n  file_path?: string;\n  description?: string;\n  size?: number;\n  created_at?: string;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## API 使用示例\n\n### 1. 创建技术点（包含车型信息）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nPOST /api/v1/tech-points\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\n  \"name\": \"刀片电池技术\",\n  \"description\": \"磷酸铁锂刀片电池技术\",\n  \"tech_type\": \"technology\",\n  \"priority\": \"high\",\n  \"status\": \"active\",\n  \"tpd_id\": \"tpd_001\",\n  \"car_models_info\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"汉EV\",\n      \"brand\": \"比亚迪\",\n      \"brand_id\": 1,\n      \"series\": \"汉\",\n      \"launch_date\": \"2020-07-01\",\n      \"status\": \"active\",\n      \"application_status\": \"production\",\n      \"implementation_date\": \"2020-07-01\",\n      \"notes\": \"首款搭载刀片电池的车型\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"resources_info\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"pdf\",\n      \"name\": \"技术白皮书\",\n      \"url\": \"https://example.com/tech-whitepaper.pdf\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 更新技术点（更新车型信息）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nPUT /api/v1/tech-points/:id\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\n  \"car_models_info\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"汉EV\",",
        "signatures": {},
