        "contents": ");\n\n-- 技术推广策略表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_promotion_strategies (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    strategy_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    target_market VARCHAR(255),\n    timeline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储时间线\n    budget_range VARCHAR(100),\n    kpi_metrics TEXT, -- JSON格式存储KPI指标\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术通稿表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_press_releases (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    subtitle VARCHAR(255),\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    summary TEXT,\n    release_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    target_media TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\n    publication_date DATE,\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    seo_keywords TEXT, -- JSON数组格式\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    published_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术演讲稿表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "async function fixGEAArchitectureCarModels() {\n  await db.connect();\n  \n  try {\n    console.log('🔧 开始修复\"吉利GEA架构\"技术点的关联车型...\\n');\n    \n    // 1. 查找技术点\n    const tpSql = 'SELECT id, name FROM tech_points WHERE name = ?';\n    const techPoints = await db.query(tpSql, [TECH_POINT_NAME]) as any[];\n    \n    if (!techPoints || techPoints.length === 0) {\n      console.error(&#96;❌ 未找到技术点: ${TECH_POINT_NAME}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    const techPointId = techPoints[0].id;\n    console.log(&#96;✅ 找到技术点: ${TECH_POINT_NAME} (ID: ${techPointId})\\n&#96;);\n    \n    // 2. 检查当前关联的车型\n    const currentAssociationsSql = &#96;\n      SELECT \n        tcm.id as association_id,\n        tcm.car_model_id,\n        cm.name as car_model_name,\n        b.name as brand_name\n      FROM tech_point_car_models tcm\n      JOIN car_models cm ON tcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n      LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const currentAssociations = await db.query(currentAssociationsSql, [techPointId]) as any[];\n    \n    console.log(&#96;📋 当前关联的车型 (${currentAssociations.length} 条):&#96;);\n    currentAssociations.forEach(assoc =&gt; {\n      console.log(&#96;  - ${assoc.brand_name || '无品牌'} ${assoc.car_model_name} (关联ID: ${assoc.association_id})&#96;);\n    });\n    console.log();\n    \n    // 3. 删除所有现有关联\n    if (currentAssociations.length &gt; 0) {\n      console.log('🗑️  删除现有关联...');\n      for (const assoc of currentAssociations) {\n        try {\n          await techPointModel.disassociateCarModel(techPointId, assoc.car_model_id);\n          console.log(&#96;  ✅ 已删除关联: ${assoc.brand_name || '无品牌'} ${assoc.car_model_name}&#96;);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.warn(&#96;  ⚠️  删除关联失败: ${assoc.car_model_name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n      console.log();\n    }\n    \n    // 4. 创建或查找正确的车型\n    console.log('🚗 创建或查找正确的车型...');\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\n   */\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n    const sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en,\n          tcm.application_status, \n          tcm.implementation_date, \n          tcm.notes\n      FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n      JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n        ORDER BY COALESCE(b.name, ''), cm.name\n    &#96;;\n    \n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId]);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [];\n      \n      // 调试日志：检查返回的数据\n      if (carModels.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log(&#96;[TechPointModel] 获取技术点 ${techPointId} 的关联车型:&#96;, \n          carModels.map((cm: any) =&gt; ({\n            id: cm.id,\n            name: cm.name,\n            brand_id: cm.brand_id,\n            brand_name: cm.brand_name,\n            brand_id_ref: cm.brand_id_ref\n          }))\n        );\n      }\n      \n      return carModels;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('获取关联车型失败:', error.message);\n      // 如果表不存在，返回空数组\n      if (error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n        return [];\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 关联车型到技术点\n   */\n  async associateCarModel(\n    techPointId: number, \n    carModelId: number, \n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n {\n      for (const carModelData of tpdTechPoint.associated_car_models) {\n        try {\n          // 如果已有car_model_id，直接使用\n          let carModelId: number;\n          if (carModelData.car_model_id) {\n            const existingCarModel = await carModelModel.findById(carModelData.car_model_id);\n            if (existingCarModel) {\n              carModelId = existingCarModel.id;\n            } else {\n              // 如果ID不存在，通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n              carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n                carModelData.brand,\n                carModelData.name,\n                carModelData.type\n              );\n            }\n          } else {\n            // 通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n            carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n              carModelData.brand,\n              carModelData.name,\n              carModelData.type\n            );\n          }\n\n          // 关联车型到技术点\n          try {\n            await techPointModel.associateCarModel(\n              techPointId,\n              carModelId,\n              'planned', // 默认状态\n              null,\n              carModelData.notes || carModelData.relationship || null\n            );\n            console.log(&#96;    ✅ 关联车型: ${carModelData.brand} ${carModelData.name}&#96;);\n          } catch (error: any) {\n            // 如果已存在关联，忽略错误\n            if (!error.message?.includes('已关联') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('UNIQUE')) {\n              console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  关联车型失败: ${carModelData.brand} ${carModelData.name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  处理车型失败: ${carModelData.name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 9. 处理技术知识点（创建独立的知识点记录）\n    const knowledgePointService = new KnowledgePointService();\n    let knowledgePointCount = 0;\n\n    // 技术原理\n    if\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\nasync update(id: number, data: UpdateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除技术点（软删除）\n   */\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    // 检查是否有子技术点\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\n    if (children.length &gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with child tech points');\n    }\n\n    // 检查是否有关联的车型\n    const carModelsSql = 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM tech_point_car_models WHERE tech_point_id = ?';\n    const carModelsResult = await this.db.query(carModelsSql, [id]);\n    if (carModelsResult[0].count &gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('Cannot delete tech point with associated car models');\n    }\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE tech_points \n      SET status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [Status.ARCHIVED, id]);\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result.length &gt; 0 : result.changes &gt; 0;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 物理删除技术点\n   */\n  async hardDelete(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    // 检查是否有子技术点\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const CarSeriesEditPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\nconst loadTechPoints = async \n\n    };\n\n    loadTechPoints();\n  }, []);\n\n  // 保存车系信息\n  const handleSave = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!carSeries) return;\n\n    try {\n      setSaving(true);\n\n      const updateData: UpdateCarSeriesFormData = {\n        name: basicInfo.name,\n        description: basicInfo.description,\n        market_segment: basicInfo.market_segment,\n        launch_year: basicInfo.launch_year,\n        end_year: basicInfo.end_year,\n        metadata: {\n          keyCarModels,\n          competitors,\n          techPointIds: associatedTechPoints.map((tp) =&gt; tp.id),\n        },\n      };\n\n      const response = await carSeriesService.update(carSeries.id, updateData);\n\n      if (response.success) {\n        navigate(&#96;/car-series/${carSeries.id}&#96;);\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || \"保存失败\");\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"保存失败\");\n      console.error(\"Save error:\", err);\n    } finally {\n      setSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 关键车型管理\n  const handleAddCarModel = (carModel: KeyCarModel) =&gt; {\n    if (editingCarModel) {\n      setKeyCarModels((prev) =&gt;\n        prev.map((cm) =&gt; (cm === editingCarModel ?         "contents": "/**\n * 测试更新技术点的车型信息\n */\nasync function testUpdateCarModels(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  console.log('\\n🧪 测试 3: 更新技术点的车型信息\\n');\n  \n  try {\n    await db.connect();\n    \n    // 创建初始数据\n    const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\n      name: '测试技术点 - 更新车型',\n      description: '用于测试更新车型信息',\n      level: 1,\n      tech_type: TechType.FEATURE,\n      priority: Priority.MEDIUM,\n      status: Status.ACTIVE,\n      car_models_info: [\n        {\n          name: '初始车型',\n          brand: '初始品牌',\n          status: 'active'\n        }\n      ]\n    };\n\n    const created = await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n    console.log(&#96;✅ 创建测试技术点 (ID: ${created.id})&#96;);\n    console.log(&#96;   初始车型数量: ${created.car_models_info?.length || 0}&#96;);\n\n    // 更新车型信息\n    const updatedCarModels: CarModelInfo[] = [\n      {\n        name: '更新后的车型1',\n        brand: '更新品牌1',\n        status: 'active'\n      },\n      {\n        name: '更新后的车型2',\n        brand: '更新品牌2',\n        status: 'active'\n      }\n    ];\n\n    const updated = await techPointModel.update(created.id, {\n      car_models_info: updatedCarModels\n    });\n\n    if (updated) {\n      console.log(&#96;✅ 成功更新技术点&#96;);\n      console.log(&#96;   更新后车型数量: ${updated.car_models_info?.length || 0}&#96;);\n      \n      if (updated.car_models_info &amp;&amp; updated.car_models_info.length === 2) {\n        console.log('✅ 车型数据更新成功');\n        updated.car_models_info.forEach((car, index) =&gt; {\n          console.log(&#96;   ${index + 1}. ${car.brand} ${car.name}&#96;);\n        });\n      } else {\n        console.error('❌ 车型数据更新失败');\n      }\n    } else {\n      console.error('❌ 更新技术点失败');\n    }\n\n    // 清理\n    await techPointModel.hardDelete(created.id);\n    console.log('✅ 测试数据已清理');\n    console.log('\\n✅ 测试 3 完成\\n');\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# 技术点车型数据 API 传递验证文档\n\n## 概述\n\n本文档说明如何验证技术点关联车型数据是否可以通过 API 正确传递到本项目数据库。\n\n## 数据库变更\n\n已为 &#96;tech_points&#96; 表添加以下字段：\n\n- &#96;tpd_id&#96; (VARCHAR): TPD2 项目的原始 ID，用于同步锚点\n- &#96;car_models_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储车型信息数组\n- &#96;resources_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储资源信息数组\n- &#96;knowledge_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储知识点详情\n\n## 数据格式\n\n### CarModelInfo 接口\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface CarModelInfo {\n  id?: number;\n  name: string;\n  brand?: string;\n  brand_id?: number;\n  series?: string;\n  launch_date?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  application_status?: string;\n  implementation_date?: string;\n  notes?: string;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### ResourceInfo 接口\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface ResourceInfo {\n  type: 'pdf' | 'link' | 'image' | 'video' | 'document' | 'other';\n  name: string;\n  url?: string;\n  file_path?: string;\n  description?: string;\n  size?: number;\n  created_at?: string;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## API 使用示例\n\n### 1. 创建技术点（包含车型信息）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nPOST /api/v1/tech-points\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\n  \"name\": \"刀片电池技术\",\n  \"description\": \"磷酸铁锂刀片电池技术\",\n  \"tech_type\": \"technology\",\n  \"priority\": \"high\",\n  \"status\": \"active\",\n  \"tpd_id\": \"tpd_001\",\n  \"car_models_info\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"汉EV\",\n      \"brand\": \"比亚迪\",\n      \"brand_id\": 1,\n      \"series\": \"汉\",\n      \"launch_date\": \"2020-07-01\",\n      \"status\": \"active\",\n      \"application_status\": \"production\",\n      \"implementation_date\": \"2020-07-01\",\n      \"notes\": \"首款搭载刀片电池的车型\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"resources_info\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"pdf\",\n      \"name\": \"技术白皮书\",\n      \"url\": \"https://example.com/tech-whitepaper.pdf\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 更新技术点（更新车型信息）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nPUT /api/v1/tech-points/:id\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\n  \"car_models_info\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"汉EV\",",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "const CarModelAssociation: React.FC&lt;CarModelAssociationProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 处理删除关联\n  const handleDeleteAssociation = async (carModelId: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm(\"确定要删除这个关联吗？\")) return;\n\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.disassociateCarModelFromTechPoint(\n        techPointId,\n        carModelId,\n      );\n\n      if (response.success) {\n        await fetchAssociatedCarModels();\n        onUpdate?.();\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || \"删除关联失败\");\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"删除关联失败\");\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 打开编辑模态框\n  const openEditModal = (association: AssociatedCarModel) =&gt; {\n    setEditingAssociation(association);\n    setFormData({\n      carModelId: association.id,\n      applicationStatus: association.application_status || \"planned\",\n      implementationDate: association.implementation_date || \"\",\n      notes: association.notes || \"\",\n    });\n    setShowEditModal(true);\n  };\n\n  // 过滤关联车型\n  const filteredAssociations = associatedCarModels.filter((association) =&gt; {\n    const matchesSearch =\n      searchTerm === \"\" ||\n      association.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||\n      (association.brand?.name &amp;&amp;\n        association.brand.name\n          .toLowerCase()\n          .includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));\n\n    const matchesStatus =\n      statusFilter === \"all\" || association.application_status === statusFilter;\n\n    return matchesSearch &amp;&amp; matchesStatus;\n  });\n\n  // 获取状态颜色\n  const getStatusColor = (status?: string) =&gt; {\n    switch (status) {\n      case \"implemented\":\n        return \"bg-green-100 text-green-800\";\n      case \"in_progress\":\n        return \"bg-blue-100 text-blue-800\";\n      case \"planned\":\n        return \"bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800\";\n      case \"cancelled\":\n        return \"bg-red-100 text-red-800\";\n      default:\n        return \"bg-gray-100 text-gray-800\";\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 获取状态图标\n  const getStatusIcon = (status?: string) =&gt;\n;\n;",

brandCheckResult[0].brand_name \n                : null;\n              \n              // 验证品牌和名称是否匹配\n              const nameMatches = existingCarModel.name.trim() === carModelData.name.trim();\n              const brandMatches = existingBrandName &amp;&amp; existingBrandName.trim() === brandName;\n              \n              if (nameMatches &amp;&amp; brandMatches) {\n                // 完全匹配，使用现有车型\n                carModelId = existingCarModel.id;\n                console.log(&#96;    ℹ️  使用已存在的车型: ${brandName} ${carModelData.name.trim()} (ID: ${carModelId})&#96;);\n              } else {\n                // 不匹配，记录警告并通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n                console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  车型ID ${carModelData.car_model_id} 的品牌或名称不匹配:&#96;);\n                console.warn(&#96;       现有: ${existingBrandName || '未知品牌'} ${existingCarModel.name}&#96;);\n                console.warn(&#96;       TPD2: ${brandName} ${carModelData.name.trim()}&#96;);\n                console.warn(&#96;       将通过品牌和名称重新查找或创建车型&#96;);\n                carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n                  brandName,\n                  carModelData.name.trim(),\n                  carModelData.type\n                );\n              }\n            } else {\n              // 如果ID不存在，通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n              console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  车型ID ${carModelData.car_model_id}\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 从TPD2项目API导入所有技术点数据\n * 一次性导入所有技术点及其关联数据\n */\n\nimport axios from 'axios';\nimport { DatabaseManager, db } from '../config/database';\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel, carModelModel } from '../models';\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority, KnowledgeType, DifficultyLevel, CreateKnowledgePointDTO } from '../types/database';\nimport { KnowledgePointService } from '../services/knowledgePointService';\n\ninterface TPD2TechPoint {\n  id?: number;\n  name: string;\n  description?: string;\n  category_id?: number;\n  category_name?: string;\n  parent_id?: number | null;\n  level?: number;\n  tech_type?: string;\n  priority?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  tags?: string[] | null;\n  technical_details?: any;\n  benefits?: string[] | null;\n  applications?: string[] | null;\n  keywords?: string[] | null;\n  source_url?: string | null;\n  created_by?: string | null;\n  tech_principle?: string;\n  tech_value?: string;\n  tech_boundary?: string;\n  highlights?: string[];\n  evidence_measured?: string[];\n  evidence_certified?: string[];\n  evidence_comparison?: string[];\n  associated_car_models?: Array&lt;{\n    id?: number;\n    name: string;\n    brand: string;\n    type?: string;\n    car_model_id?: number;\n    relationship?: string;\n    notes?: string;\n  }&gt;;\n  associated_resources?: any[];\n}\n\n/**\n * 查找或创建技术分类\n */\nasync function findOrCreateCategory(\n  categoryId: number | undefined,\n  categoryName: string | undefined\n): Promise&lt;number | null&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 查找或创建车型\n */\nasync function findOrCreateCarModel(\n  brandName: string,\n  carModelName: string,\n  type?: string\n): Promise&lt;number&gt; {\n  // 验证输入\n  if (!brandName || brandName.trim() === '') {\n    throw new Error('品牌名称不能为空');\n  }\n  if (!carModelName || carModelName.trim() === '') {\n    throw new Error('车型名称不能为空');\n  }\n  \n  const trimmedBrandName = brandName.trim();\n  const trimmedCarModelName = carModelName.trim();\n  \n  // 先查找或创建品牌\n  const brandId = await findOrCreateBrand(trimmedBrandName);\n\n  // 查找车型\n  const carModelSql = 'SELECT id FROM car_models WHERE brand_id = ? AND name = ?';\n  const carModelResult = await db.query(carModelSql, [brandId, trimmedCarModelName]);\n  \n  if (Array.isArray(carModelResult) &amp;&amp; carModelResult.length &gt; 0) {\n    return carModelResult[0].id;\n  }\n\n  // 创建车型\n  const categoryMap: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n    '轿车': 'sedan',\n    'SUV': 'suv',\n    'MPV': 'mpv',\n    '跑车': 'coupe',\n    '皮卡': 'pickup',\n  };\n  \n  const category = type ? categoryMap[type] || null : null;\n  \n  const insertCarModelSql = &#96;\n    INSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, category, status) \n    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\n  &#96;;\n  const insertResult = await db.query(insertCarModelSql, [\n    brandId,\n    trimmedCarModelName,\n    category,\n    'active'\n  ]);\n  const carModelId = insertResult.lastID || insertResult.insertId;\n  console.log(&#96;  ✅ 创建车型: ${trimmedBrandName} ${trimmedCarModelName} (ID: ${carModelId})&#96;);\n  return carModelId;\n}\n\n/**\n * 导入单个技术点\n */\nasync function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "export class TPDSyncService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 同步单个技术点\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{created: boolean}&gt;} 返回是否为新创建\n   */\n  private async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 获取技术点详情（包含关联数据）\n      const detailResponse = await axios.get(\n        &#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points/${tpdTechPoint.id}&#96;,\n        {\n          params: {\n            includeAssociations: true,\n          },\n          timeout: 30000,\n        }\n      );\n\n      if (detailResponse.data.code !== 200 || !detailResponse.data.data) {\n        throw new Error('获取技术点详情失败');\n      }\n\n      const techPointDetail = detailResponse.data.data;\n\n      // 转换车型数据为 CarModelInfo 格式\n      const carModelsInfo: CarModelInfo[] = [];\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\n        for (const carModel of techPointDetail.carModels) {\n          carModelsInfo.push({\n            id: carModel.id || carModel.car_model_id,\n            name: carModel.name || carModel.model_name || '',\n            brand: carModel.brand || carModel.brand_name,\n            brand_id: carModel.brand_id,\n            series: carModel.series || carModel.series_name,\n            launch_date: carModel.launch_date || carModel.launch_year?.toString(),\n            status: carModel.status,\n            application_status: carModel.application_status || carModel.status,\n            implementation_date: carModel.implementation_date,\n            notes: carModel.notes || carModel.relationship\n          });\n        }\n        logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${carModelsInfo.length} 个车型，已转换为 JSON 格式&#96;);\n      }\n\n      // 转换资源数据为 ResourceInfo 格式\n      const resourcesInfo: ResourceInfo[] = [];\n      if (techPointDetail.resources &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.resources)) {\n        for (const resource of techPointDetail.resources)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 查找或创建车型\n */\nasync function findOrCreateCarModel(\n  brandName: string,\n  carModelName: string,\n  type?: string\n): Promise&lt;number&gt; {\n  // 先查找或创建品牌\n  const brandId = await findOrCreateBrand(brandName);\n\n  // 查找车型\n  const carModelSql = 'SELECT id FROM car_models WHERE brand_id = ? AND name = ?';\n  const carModelResult = await db.query(carModelSql, [brandId, carModelName]);\n  \n  if (Array.isArray(carModelResult) &amp;&amp; carModelResult.length &gt; 0) {\n    return carModelResult[0].id;\n  }\n\n  // 创建车型\n  const categoryMap: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n    '轿车': 'sedan',\n    'SUV': 'suv',\n    'MPV': 'mpv',\n    '跑车': 'coupe',\n    '皮卡': 'pickup',\n  };\n  \n  const category = type ? categoryMap[type] || null : null;\n  \n  const insertCarModelSql = &#96;\n    INSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, category, status) \n    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\n  &#96;;\n  const insertResult = await db.query(insertCarModelSql, [\n    brandId,\n    carModelName,\n    category,\n    'active'\n  ]);\n  const carModelId = insertResult.lastID || insertResult.insertId;\n  console.log(&#96;  ✅ 创建车型: ${brandName} ${carModelName} (ID: ${carModelId})&#96;);\n  return carModelId;\n}\n\n/**\n * 导入单个技术点\n */\nasync function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "async function fixGEAArchitectureCarModels() {\n\n    }\n    \n    // 4. 创建或查找正确的车型\n    console.log('🚗 创建或查找正确的车型...');\n    const carModelIds: number[] = [];\n    \n    for (const carModel of CORRECT_CAR_MODELS) {\n      try {\n        const carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(carModel.brand, carModel.name);\n        carModelIds.push(carModelId);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        console.error(&#96;  ❌ 处理车型失败: ${carModel.brand} ${carModel.name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n      }\n    }\n    console.log();\n    \n    // 5. 关联正确的车型到技术点\n    console.log('🔗 关联车型到技术点...');\n    let successCount = 0;\n    let failCount = 0;\n    \n    for (let i = 0; i &lt; CORRECT_CAR_MODELS.length; i++) {\n      const carModel = CORRECT_CAR_MODELS[i];\n      const carModelId = carModelIds[i];\n      \n      if (!carModelId) {\n        console.warn(&#96;  ⚠️  跳过: ${carModel.brand} ${carModel.name} (未找到车型ID)&#96;);\n        failCount++;\n        continue;\n      }\n      \n      try {\n        await techPointModel.associateCarModel(\n          techPointId,\n          carModelId,\n          'planned',\n          undefined,\n          '关联方式：标配'\n        );\n        console.log(&#96;  ✅ 关联成功: ${carModel.brand} ${carModel.name}&#96;);\n        successCount++;\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        if (error.message?.includes('已关联')) {\n          console.log(&#96;  ℹ️  已存在关联: ${carModel.brand} ${carModel.name}&#96;);\n          successCount++;\n        } else {\n          console.error(&#96;         "contents": "{\n  \"car_models_info\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"汉EV\",\n      \"brand\": \"比亚迪\",\n      \"status\": \"active\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"唐EV\",\n      \"brand\": \"比亚迪\",\n      \"status\": \"active\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. 获取技术点（包含车型信息）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nGET /api/v1/tech-points/:id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n响应示例：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"data\": {\n    \"id\": 1,\n    \"name\": \"刀片电池技术\",\n    \"tpd_id\": \"tpd_001\",\n    \"car_models_info\": [\n      {\n        \"name\": \"汉EV\",\n        \"brand\": \"比亚迪\",\n        \"status\": \"active\"\n      }\n    ],\n    \"resources_info\": [...],\n    ...\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 运行测试脚本\n\n### 执行数据库迁移\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd backend\nnpm run ts-node src/scripts/migrations/003_add_tpd_fields_to_tech_points.ts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 运行验证测试\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd backend\nnpm run ts-node src/scripts/test-tech-point-car-models-api.ts\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n测试脚本将验证：\n\n1. ✅ 创建技术点时包含车型信息\n2. ✅ 通过 tpd_id 查找技术点\n3. ✅ 更新技术点的车型信息\n4. ✅ 数据正确保存到数据库\n5. ✅ 数据正确从数据库读取\n\n## TPD2 同步\n\n当从 TPD2 同步技术点数据时，&#96;TPDSyncService&#96; 会自动：\n\n1. 从 TPD2 API 获取技术点详情（包含 &#96;carModels&#96; 数据）\n2. 将 &#96;carModels&#96; 转换为 &#96;CarModelInfo[]&#96; 格式\n3. 保存到 &#96;car_models_info&#96; JSON 字段\n4. 使用 &#96;tpd_id&#96; 作为同步锚点，避免重复创建\n\n### 同步 API\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nPOST /api/v1/tech-points/sync\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 注意事项\n\n1. **数据格式**: 确保传入的 &#96;car_models_info&#96; 是有效的 JSON 数组\n2. **字段验证**: &#96;name&#96; 字段是必需的，其他字段可选\n3. **tpd_id**: 用于 TPD2 同步，建议在创建时设置\n4. **向后兼容**: 现有的关联表 &#96;tech_point_car_models&#96; 仍然保留，但新数据优先使用 JSON 字段\n\n## 故障排查\n\n### 问题：车型数据没有保存\n\n**检查项：**\n1. 确认数据库迁移已执行\n2. 检查 API 请求的 Content-Type 是否为 &#96;application/json&#96;\n3. 查看后端日志是否有错误信息",

        "contents": "# 技术点车型数据 API 传递验证文档\n\n## 概述\n\n本文档说明如何验证技术点关联车型数据是否可以通过 API 正确传递到本项目数据库。\n\n## 数据库变更\n\n已为 &#96;tech_points&#96; 表添加以下字段：\n\n- &#96;tpd_id&#96; (VARCHAR): TPD2 项目的原始 ID，用于同步锚点\n- &#96;car_models_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储车型信息数组\n- &#96;resources_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储资源信息数组\n- &#96;knowledge_info&#96; (TEXT/JSONB): JSON 格式存储知识点详情\n\n## 数据格式\n\n### CarModelInfo 接口\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface CarModelInfo {\n  id?: number;\n  name: string;\n  brand?: string;\n  brand_id?: number;\n  series?: string;\n  launch_date?: string;\n  status?: string;\n  application_status?: string;\n  implementation_date?: string;\n  notes?: string;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### ResourceInfo 接口\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface ResourceInfo {\n  type: 'pdf' | 'link' | 'image' | 'video' | 'document' | 'other';\n  name: string;\n  url?: string;\n  file_path?: string;\n  description?: string;\n  size?: number;\n  created_at?: string;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## API 使用示例\n\n### 1. 创建技术点（包含车型信息）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nPOST /api/v1/tech-points\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\n  \"name\": \"刀片电池技术\",\n  \"description\": \"磷酸铁锂刀片电池技术\",\n  \"tech_type\": \"technology\",\n  \"priority\": \"high\",\n  \"status\": \"active\",\n  \"tpd_id\": \"tpd_001\",\n  \"car_models_info\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"汉EV\",\n      \"brand\": \"比亚迪\",\n      \"brand_id\": 1,\n      \"series\": \"汉\",\n      \"launch_date\": \"2020-07-01\",\n      \"status\": \"active\",\n      \"application_status\": \"production\",\n      \"implementation_date\": \"2020-07-01\",\n      \"notes\": \"首款搭载刀片电池的车型\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"resources_info\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"pdf\",\n      \"name\": \"技术白皮书\",\n      \"url\": \"https://example.com/tech-whitepaper.pdf\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 更新技术点（更新车型信息）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nPUT /api/v1/tech-points/:id\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\n  \"car_models_info\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"汉EV\",",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "import axios from 'axios';\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\nimport { \n  CreateTechPointDTO, \n  UpdateTechPointDTO, \n  Status, \n  TechType, \n  Priority,\n  CarModelInfo,\n  ResourceInfo,\n  KnowledgeInfo\n} from '../types/database';\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\n\n/**\n * TPD2 同步服务\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\n */\nexport class TPDSyncService {\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\n\n  constructor() {\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\n   */\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n    const sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en,\n          tcm.application_status, \n          tcm.implementation_date, \n          tcm.notes\n      FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n      JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n        ORDER BY COALESCE(b.name, ''), cm.name\n    &#96;;\n    \n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId]);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [];\n      \n      // 调试日志：检查返回的数据\n      if (carModels.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log(&#96;[TechPointModel] 获取技术点 ${techPointId} 的关联车型:&#96;, \n          carModels.map((cm: any) =&gt; ({\n            id: cm.id,\n            name: cm.name,\n            brand_id: cm.brand_id,\n            brand_name: cm.brand_name,\n            brand_id_ref: cm.brand_id_ref\n          }))\n        );\n      }\n      \n      return carModels;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('获取关联车型失败:', error.message);\n      // 如果表不存在，返回空数组\n      if (error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n        return [];\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 关联车型到技术点\n   */\n  async associateCarModel(\n    techPointId: number, \n    carModelId: number, \n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/scripts/migrations/003_add_tpd_fields_to_tech_points.sql",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

        },
        "contents": "-- 迁移脚本：为 tech_points 表添加 TPD2 同步相关字段\n-- 执行日期：2025-12-08\n-- 说明：添加 tpd_id, car_models_info, resources_info 字段，实现单表管理\n\n-- SQLite 版本\n-- 注意：SQLite 不支持直接 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 添加多个列，需要逐个添加\n\n-- 1. 添加 tpd_id 字段（用于存储 TPD2 项目的原始 ID，作为同步锚点）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN tpd_id VARCHAR(100);\n\n-- 2. 添加 car_models_info 字段（JSON 格式存储车型信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN car_models_info TEXT;\n\n-- 3. 添加 resources_info 字段（JSON 格式存储资源信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN resources_info TEXT;\n\n-- 4. 添加 knowledge_info 字段（JSON 格式存储知识点详情，整合现有字段）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN knowledge_info TEXT;\n\n-- 5. 为 tpd_id 创建索引（用于快速查找和同步）\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n\n-- PostgreSQL 版本（如果需要）\n-- 注意：PostgreSQL 支持一次添加多个列\n/*\nALTER TABLE tech_points \n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tpd_id VARCHAR(100),\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS car_models_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS resources_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_info JSONB;\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n*/",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 关联车型到技术点\n   */\n  async associateCarModel(\n    techPointId: number, \n    carModelId: number, \n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    // 检查是否已存在关联\n    const existingSql = &#96;\n      SELECT id FROM tech_point_car_models \n      WHERE tech_point_id = ? AND car_model_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\n    \n    if (existing.length &gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\n    }\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      techPointId,\n      carModelId,\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\n      implementationDate || null,\n      notes || null\n    ];\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result[0];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\n   */\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "// 技术点接口\nexport interface TechPoint extends BaseEntity {\n  name: string;\n  description?: string;\n  category_id?: number;\n  parent_id?: number;\n  level: number;\n  tech_type: TechType;\n  priority: Priority;\n  status: Status;\n  tags?: string[];\n  technical_details?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;\n  benefits?: string[];\n  applications?: string[];\n  keywords?: string[];\n  source_url?: string;\n  created_by?: string;\n  // TPD2 同步相关字段\n  tpd_id?: string; // TPD2 项目的原始 ID，用于同步锚点\n  car_models_info?: CarModelInfo[]; // JSON 格式存储车型信息\n  resources_info?: ResourceInfo[]; // JSON 格式存储资源信息\n  knowledge_info?: KnowledgeInfo; // JSON 格式存储知识点详情\n}\n\n// 技术点与车型关联接口\nexport interface TechPointCarModel extends BaseEntity {\n  tech_point_id: number\n;\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "// 技术点接口",
            "lineNumber": 221

{\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const response =\n        await techPointService.getTechPointCarModels(techPointId);\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setAssociatedCarModels(response.data);\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || \"获取关联车型失败\");\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"获取关联车型失败\");\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 获取可用的车型列表\n  const fetchAvailableCarModels = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await carModelService.getAll({\n        page: 1,\n        pageSize: 1000,\n      });\n      if (response.data) {\n        setAvailableCarModels(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error(\"获取车型列表失败:\", err);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    fetchAssociatedCarModels();\n    fetchAvailableCarModels();\n  }, [techPointId]);\n\n  // 处理添加关联\n  const handleAddAssociation = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "async function fixGEAArchitectureCarModels() {\n  await db.connect();\n  \n  try {\n    console.log('🔧 开始修复\"吉利GEA架构\"技术点的关联车型...\\n');\n    \n    // 1. 查找技术点\n    const tpSql = 'SELECT id, name FROM tech_points WHERE name = ?';\n    const techPoints = await db.query(tpSql, [TECH_POINT_NAME]) as any[];\n    \n    if (!techPoints || techPoints.length === 0) {\n      console.error(&#96;❌ 未找到技术点: ${TECH_POINT_NAME}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    const techPointId = techPoints[0].id;\n    console.log(&#96;✅ 找到技术点: ${TECH_POINT_NAME} (ID: ${techPointId})\\n&#96;);\n    \n    // 2. 检查当前关联的车型\n    const currentAssociationsSql = &#96;\n      SELECT \n        tcm.id as association_id,\n        tcm.car_model_id,\n        cm.name as car_model_name,\n        b.name as brand_name\n      FROM tech_point_car_models tcm\n      JOIN car_models cm ON tcm.car_model_id = cm.id\n      LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const currentAssociations = await db.query(currentAssociationsSql, [techPointId]) as any[];\n    \n    console.log(&#96;📋 当前关联的车型 (${currentAssociations.length} 条):&#96;);\n    currentAssociations.forEach(assoc =&gt; {\n      console.log(&#96;  - ${assoc.brand_name || '无品牌'} ${assoc.car_model_name} (关联ID: ${assoc.association_id})&#96;);\n    });\n    console.log();\n    \n    // 3. 删除所有现有关联\n    if (currentAssociations.length &gt; 0) {\n      console.log('🗑️  删除现有关联...');\n      for (const assoc of currentAssociations) {\n        try {\n          await techPointModel.disassociateCarModel(techPointId, assoc.car_model_id);\n          console.log(&#96;  ✅ 已删除关联: ${assoc.brand_name || '无品牌'} ${assoc.car_model_name}&#96;);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.warn(&#96;  ⚠️  删除关联失败: ${assoc.car_model_name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n      console.log();\n    }\n    \n    // 4. 创建或查找正确的车型\n    console.log('🚗 创建或查找正确的车型...');\n}",

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n\n    }\n    if (tpdTechPoint.evidence_certified &amp;&amp; tpdTechPoint.evidence_certified.length &gt; 0) {\n      technicalDetails.evidence_certified = tpdTechPoint.evidence_certified;\n    }\n    if (tpdTechPoint.evidence_comparison &amp;&amp; tpdTechPoint.evidence_comparison.length &gt; 0) {\n      technicalDetails.evidence_comparison = tpdTechPoint.evidence_comparison;\n    }\n    // 合并原有的technical_details\n    if (tpdTechPoint.technical_details) {\n      Object.assign(technicalDetails, tpdTechPoint.technical_details);\n    }\n\n    // 6. 准备技术点数据\n    const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\n      name: tpdTechPoint.name,\n      description: tpdTechPoint.description || undefined,\n      category_id: categoryId || undefined,\n      parent_id: tpdTechPoint.parent_id ?? undefined,\n      level: tpdTechPoint.level || 1,\n      tech_type: techType,\n      priority: priority,\n      status: status,\n      tags: tpdTechPoint.tags || undefined,\n      technical_details: Object.keys(technicalDetails).length &gt; 0 ? technicalDetails : undefined,\n      benefits: tpdTechPoint.benefits || undefined,\n      applications: tpdTechPoint.applications || undefined,\n      keywords: tpdTechPoint.keywords || undefined,\n      source_url: tpdTechPoint.source_url || undefined,\n      created_by: tpdTechPoint.created_by || undefined,\n    };\n\n    // 7. 检查技术点是否已存在（通过名称）\n    const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n    const existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === tpdTechPoint.name);\n\n    let techPointId: number;\n    if (existing) {\n      // 更新现有技术点\n      await techPointModel.update(existing.id, techPointData);\n}",

        "contents": "如果TPD2项目正在运行，可以直接从API获取数据：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd backend\nnpx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts [tpd-api-url]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**示例：**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 使用默认API地址（http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1）\nnpx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts\n\n# 指定TPD2 API地址\nnpx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/import-tech-points-from-tpd2.ts http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**环境变量配置：**\n你也可以在 &#96;.env&#96; 文件中设置：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nTPD_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 功能特性\n\n### 自动处理\n\n1. **技术分类**：如果分类不存在，会自动创建\n2. **品牌和车型**：如果品牌或车型不存在，会自动创建\n3. **技术点更新**：如果技术点已存在（通过名称匹配），会更新而不是创建新记录\n4. **关联车型**：自动关联技术点与车型\n\n### 数据映射\n\n- **技术类型**：&#96;feature&#96;, &#96;technology&#96;, &#96;innovation&#96;, &#96;improvement&#96;\n- **优先级**：&#96;low&#96;, &#96;medium&#96;, &#96;high&#96;, &#96;critical&#96;\n- **状态**：&#96;active&#96;, &#96;inactive&#96;, &#96;draft&#96;, &#96;archived&#96;\n- **车型类型**：&#96;轿车&#96; → &#96;sedan&#96;, &#96;SUV&#96; → &#96;suv&#96;, &#96;MPV&#96; → &#96;mpv&#96;, 等\n\n### 技术详情字段合并\n\n脚本会自动将以下字段合并到 &#96;technical_details&#96; 中：\n- &#96;tech_principle&#96; - 技术原理\n- &#96;tech_value&#96; - 技术价值\n- &#96;tech_boundary&#96; - 技术边界\n- &#96;highlights&#96; - 亮点\n- &#96;evidence_measured&#96; - 实测数据\n- &#96;evidence_certified&#96; - 认证数据\n- &#96;evidence_comparison&#96; - 对比数据\n\n## 注意事项\n\n1. **数据清空**：导入前建议先清空现有技术点数据（使用 &#96;clear-tech-points-data.ts&#96;）\n2. **数据库连接**：确保数据库配置正确（&#96;.env&#96; 文件或环境变量）\n3. **API可用性**：使用API导入时，确保TPD2项目正在运行\n4. **数据完整性**：导入过程中会显示详细的进度和错误信息\n\n## 错误处理\n\n- 如果某个技术点导入失败，脚本会继续处理其他技术点\n- 所有错误会在最后统一显示\n- 已存在的关联关系不会重复创建（会忽略错误）",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

已创建用于清除并同步技术点车辆关联的脚本。总结如下：

## 已创建的文件

### 1. **主脚本文件**
   - `backend/src/scripts/clear-and-sync-car-models-from-tpd2.ts`
   - 功能：
     - 清除所有技术点的车辆关联（删除 `tech_point_car_models` 表中的所有记录）
     - 从TPD2 API获取所有技术点及其关联的车型信息
     - 重新建立技术点与车型的关联关系

### 2. **使用说明文档**
   - `backend/src/scripts/README-CLEAR-AND-SYNC-CAR-MODELS.md`
   - 包含使用方法、配置说明和执行流程

## 使用方法

### 运行脚本：

```bash
cd backend
npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/clear-and-sync-car-models-from-tpd2.ts
```

### 环境变量配置：

确保设置了TPD2 API地址（可选，默认使用 `http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1`）：

```bash
export TPD_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1
```

## 脚本执行流程

1. 连接数据库
2. 清除所有现有关联：删除 `tech_point_car_models` 表中的所有记录
3. 从TPD2获取数据：分页获取所有技术点及其详细信息（包含关联车型）
4. 同步车辆关联：
   - 查找或创建品牌
   - 查找或创建车型
   - 建立技术点与车型的关联关系

## 输出信息

脚本会输出详细的执行日志，包括：
- 清除的关联数量
- 从TPD2获取的技术点数量
- 每个技术点同步的车型数量
- 最终统计信息（成功/失败数量、总关联数）

## 注意事项

1. 数据备份：执行前建议备份数据库，因为会清除所有现有关联
2. TPD2 API可用性：确保TPD2 API服务正在运行且可访问
3. 执行时间：根据技术点数量，可能需要较长时间执行

脚本已就绪，可以运行以清除所有技术点的车辆关联，并从TPD2同步最新的车辆关联信息。
